seo.title: Octopus Energy: Magic Ink genAI customer agent - 35% of emails drafted by AI (2023)
seo.meta_description: Magic Ink, Kraken's generative AI, drafts around 35% of Octopus Energy's customer emails under human supervision, with satisfaction higher than that of agents alone.
seo.resume_citable: At Octopus Energy, the genAI tool Magic Ink assists the drafting of around 35% of customer emails and has summarized more than 6.2 million calls, with the autonomous agent Arlo handling 8,000 emails a week at 76% satisfaction versus 72% for agents.

faq.q: Does Magic Ink replace Octopus Energy's agents?
faq.a: No. The tool drafts a reply; the agent reviews, edits, and sends. The human stays the sender, and the autonomous agent Arlo is confined to simple requests.

faq.q: What is the satisfaction level of Octopus's AI?
faq.a: The Arlo agent scored 76% satisfaction during its trial versus 72% for human-agent replies, and the CEO cited 80% for AI versus 65% for agents in 2023.

pattern: genAI customer agent (drafting assistance + autonomous agent)
objectif_business: Absorb the volume of customer emails without scaling headcount, holding a satisfaction level at least equal to that of human agents and reducing the cost per case.
points_cles: GenAI assistance for drafting email replies, under human supervision.
Magic Ink tool integrated into the Kraken platform, plus the autonomous agent Arlo.
About 35% of emails drafted with assistance; satisfaction 80% versus 65%.
Evidence B, confirmed status in production at group scale.
description: Magic Ink is the genAI tool integrated into Octopus's Kraken platform. When an agent opens a customer email, the tool reads the full account history and product data, then drafts a reply in the agent's tone. It annotates verified facts with their source and highlights what it could not verify. The agent reviews, adjusts if needed, and sends: the human remains the sender. About 35% of emails are written with this assistance, and nearly one in three messages generated by Magic Ink is sent with little or no editing. Octopus then tested Arlo, an agent that answers simple requests on its own (tariff renewal, direct-debit date, account details), excluding vulnerable customers and complex cases. During the trial, Arlo handled about 8,000 emails a week, or 4% of the customer emails received in the UK.

Workload covered on customer emails (CEO statement, 2023)

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified platform case study (techUK/Kraken) with precise volumes, confirmed by an official brand release and by the national press (The Times relayed by City AM) naming the CEO. Consistent sources.

stack_technique.detail: Octopus Energy Group's customer operations platform (account, billing, interactions), the base that provides the unified history the genAI relies on.
GenAI tool integrated into Kraken: it drafts replies in the agent's tone, annotates verified facts with their source, and highlights unverified text; it also summarizes calls.
GPT-type text-generation models used by Magic Ink; Octopus does not publish the exact version or provider.
Autonomous agent tested by Octopus on simple requests (tariffs, direct debits, account details), with exclusion of vulnerable customers and human escalation.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on each incoming email, with continuous retraining on the platform's customer history.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Octopus's customer service teams, tooled by the Kraken team that maintains the models and guardrails.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The full account history (contract, bills, past exchanges) and the post-reply satisfaction score. Without access to this unified history, the draft loses relevance and the share of messages sent without editing collapses.

etapes.detail: The email arrives in Kraken, which gathers the account history and associated product data.
Magic Ink generates a reply in the agent's tone, annotates verified facts with their source, and highlights unverified text.
The agent checks, corrects if necessary, and sends. The agent is the sender, not the machine.
Within a framed scope (tariffs, direct debits, account details), the Arlo agent answers on its own and hands off to a human for any sensitive or vulnerable case.

playbook.action: Unify the customer history (contract, billing, past exchanges) in a single view accessible to the system and to agents.
playbook.livrable: 360 customer record queryable in real time

playbook.action: Connect an LLM in supervised-draft mode on the email channel, with annotation of verified facts and highlighting of unverified text.
playbook.livrable: Drafting assistant piloted on an email queue

playbook.action: Measure the usage rate, the share of drafts sent without editing, and post-reply satisfaction; define exclusion rules (vulnerable cases, disputes).
Extend the assistance to all agents and add automatic call summarization.
playbook.livrable: General rollout with continuous quality control

playbook.action: Test an autonomous agent on a bounded scope of simple requests, with systematic human escalation and a satisfaction comparison vs agents.

replication.equipe: 2-3 developers/ML engineers + 1 PM + a core of reference agents for review and QA of replies
prerequis_data: corpus of past emails to calibrate tone
product reference accessible in real time
prerequis_orga: customer service willing to supervise rather than write from scratch
stack_possible: enterprise LLM (GPT-type) grounded on in-house data
replication.premiere_etape: Unify the customer history in a single view and connect an LLM in supervised-draft mode on one channel (email).

statut_vivant.note: Magic Ink is in production at the scale of the Kraken group (Octopus and licensees). Arlo was extended after a three-month trial in the UK.

transposable_ue.note: The pattern (genAI drafting assistance, supervised agent) is GDPR-compatible because the human stays in the loop and sends the message. Magic Ink annotates verified facts with their source and flags unverified text, which limits the risk of a wrong answer. The autonomous agent Arlo is framed to exclude vulnerable customers and sensitive cases, a useful precaution under the AI Act.
